title: AI connections
connectionIntro: Enter an API base URL and key to see its models. Save the connection to refresh the list later. You can add a model ID when you want to test a model or configure a tool.
manualConnectionHint: Create a key on the provider’s official site, then enter its endpoint, model ID, and key in the compatible app’s own settings.
manualSetup: In a tool that supports custom endpoints, open its model settings, choose the {{provider}} protocol, and enter the base URL and model ID “{{model}}”. If the tool requires a key, get one from the provider's official console and enter it in that tool; VibeHub never displays its saved copy.
noVerifiedTools: No confirmed compatible tool is listed in the catalog; check the tool's manual setup first.
noAutomaticInjection: VibeHub does not copy keys into other tools. Automatic setup is enabled only for tools with a tested adapter.
leaveBlankToKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved key
apiKeyStoredVault: The key is stored only in the Windows Credential Manager — never in files or logs.
keyScopeChange: Changing the provider or base URL host clears the saved key. Enter a key for the new service.
workersAccountId: Replace ACCOUNT_ID in the Base URL with your Cloudflare account ID.
testConsent: Testing sends a real request to the service and may consume quota. Continue?
redacted: Sensitive keys/details are redacted from the report.
customNote: Cost and terms are defined by the endpoint itself.
agentIntegration: Connections are entered through each tool's own settings; 'ready to configure' is different from 'tested inside the tool'.
noModels: No models returned by the provider.
proxyTroubleshooting: If the service did not respond, check your internet connection and global proxy profile, host, port and HTTP or SOCKS5 type, then run the proxy test. Other causes are also possible.
previewKeyRequired: Enter an API key to preview models. To use a saved key, refresh the list on the connection card.
noNotesHint: Open a provider and write a note to keep its quirks handy.
testNeedsModel: Pick a model first — testing sends a real request with the selected model.
duplicateNameWarning: Another connection already uses this name. Adding the model or host helps tell them apart.
savedKeyInUse: Using the key saved in the vault for this connection.
selectProvider: Select a provider to see details.
